svg.title: rev parent lattice
svg.desc: All structures use the saved parent bulk atomic coordinates, with only rigid orthographic projection and integer translations of the saved B=(0,6.4092,0)angstrom vector. Three saved-cell repeats along b give120atoms and19.2276angstrom cell extent, equal to six primitive b periods. Mo(1) is authenticated atoms9–16 and Mo(2) atoms1–8. Each family contains four individual parallel chains. True chains use pairs(9,11),(10,12),(13,15),(14,16) and(1,3),(2,4),(5,7),(6,8), continued through integer b images. No artificial separation, coordinate jitter, displacement amplification or mode direction is introduced. Looking along b collapses successive atoms of a chain onto its cross-section. The along-a view exposes the b extension; coincident projected chains remain coincident. Each panel has its own uniform scale and an orthonormal camera, preserving internal aspect ratio. a and c remain monoclinic. Blue identifies Mo(1), orange Mo(2), and faint yellow sulfur provides the bulk-lattice context. Colored lines follow actual Mo-chain neighbors; faint Mo-S connections are geometric guides, not a bond-order result.
